procedure.history: last50 legal completed matches for ability; last10 old residuals for trajectory; point-count weighted
procedure.human: surface + opponent interaction + old opponent-adjusted residual correction shrunk by 1000 pseudo-points; deterministic solver; no fitted final-win bonus
procedure.matchup: add own server win rate and opponent conceded win rate minus legal league mean; clip [.30,.90] only for numerical/boundary sanity
procedure.pooling: tour -> player overall with 300 pseudo-points -> player surface with 300 pseudo-points; separate first/second/first-in channels
procedure.unsupported: Physical, true recent form, weather, travel, style and motivation explicitly BLOCKED_DATA; no proxy claiming these measurements

scope: Separate ATP/WTA evidence-limited competent-human procedure; not complete human research
